kalala.p: [Kala+lā+a] (na) CL=7 [Kala+ala. Kalaṃ jarataṃ lātīti kalalo. Dhāna, ṭī. 239. Kalīyati parimīyati udakametenāti kalalaṃ apatthinnaṃ. Moga, 7. 182.] (1) An embryo at the moment of conception. An aggregate form that is in his mother's womb as a state of rebirth-linking. See also - Kalalarūpa. (2) Mother's womb that is a located place of an embryo at the moment of rebirth-linking. (3) (A) Mud. (B) Resin (such resin of a tree). (C) Resin that is to dye for color. See - Kalalalepa. (Ti) (4) Mud that is a sensual pleasure mud. See also - kāmapaṅka. (5) One who is similar to mud.

kalalarūpa.cp: neut. the first stage in the formation of the foetus.
kalalarūpa.p: [Kalala+rūpa] (na) CL=7 The first stage of the formation of the fetus. A form that is a first state of a rebirth- linking (embryo state) in his mother's womb. (In that form includes three kalāpa(group of elementary particles (Kāya, bhāva, Vatthudasaka), and 30 forms that are for male and female. For neutral there are 20 forms and 2 Kalāpa (group of elementary particles) they are Kāya and Vatthudasaka).
a: ကလလရေကြည်ရုပ်၊ အမိဝမ်း၌ ပဋိသန္ဓေနေသော အခါ အစစွာ ဖြစ်သောရုပ်။(ထိုရုပ်၌ ယောက်ကျားမိန်းမတို့အား ကာယ, ဘာဝ, ဝတ္ထုဒသက ကလာပ် ၃-စည်း=ရုပ် ၃ဝ-ပါဝင်၍ နပုံးတို့အားကာယ, ဝတ္ထုဒသက ကလာပ် ၂-စည်း=ရုပ် ၂ဝ-ပါဝင်၏)။
